summary: Verified Meta Conversions API integration end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass covering GET (masked, admin-only, staff 403), PUT (save + preserve token on blank + staff 403), POST /test (clean 400 with Meta's real error 'Invalid OAuth access token data.'), POST /leads/{id}/meta/send-lead (admin returns clean 400, staff 403). Frontend: Settings card renders with all data-testids (pixel_id, access_token, test_event_code, country_code, enabled switch, save, send-test); save shows success toast; after reload access_token field is blank with placeholder '•••••••• saved — leave blank to keep'; Configured badge appears; Send test event with fake creds shows clean error toast 'Invalid OAuth access token data.' (no crash). Converted lead detail dialog (via ?lead=<id>) shows 'Send to Meta' button (data-testid=lead-send-meta-btn); clicking with fake creds shows inline 'Meta send failed · Invalid OAuth access token data.' (clean 400, no crash). DB cleanup performed: app_settings.meta_capi doc deleted (1), lead.meta_lead unset (1).
critical_code_review_comments: meta_capi.public_status correctly masks access_token and only exposes has_token boolean — good.
PUT settings correctly preserves the previously saved token when access_token is blank/None (server-side merge).
convert_lead wraps send_lead_event in try/except so Meta failures never break /convert — verified conceptually via code review.
manual /meta/send-lead correctly enforces admin-only (returns 403 to staff) in addition to require_edit('leads').

context_for_next_testing_agent: Meta CAPI integration is stable and clean. Backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration73_meta_capi.py and can be re-run for regression. Frontend deep-links to a lead via /leads?lead=<id>. If testing again with real Meta creds, remember to clean up app_settings.meta_capi and lead.meta_lead afterwards.
